_comment: ProLink social content opportunity backlog — 2026. Source of truth for scheduled social topic selection. Hand-editable. editorial_engine.py computes composite scores and rank at load time; there is no separate build step, so this file never goes stale against its own ranking. Scores (1-10): rel=topic relevance to a 20-500 seat LA business executive, fresh=how much this reflects 2026 rather than recycled MSP material, val=audience value, orig=originality of the angle, biz=business importance of the decision it informs, vis=visual/carousel potential, share=shareability between executives, exp=depth of genuine ProLink expertise behind it.

scoring.note: Composite is the weighted mean. The engine additionally applies live modifiers at selection time: recency decay against the published ledger, theme-balance correction, seasonal windows, and a hard anti-repetition block.
